name: Transfer Stock Analyst
description: A local football-finance intelligence site for transfer rumors, reporter credibility, listed-club exposure, and market-context research.

capabilities.name: ask
capabilities.description: Ask a grounded natural-language question over the local dashboard payload and evidence index.

capabilities.name: club_context
capabilities.description: Explain public-club exposure, stock-path context, match markers, and current rumor signals.

capabilities.name: reporter_context
capabilities.description: Explain reporter/source credibility from local historical claim outcomes.

capabilities.name: scenario_context
capabilities.description: Summarize bounded scenario-swarm outputs when available.

example_questions: Explain the strongest current listed-club rumor
Who are the strongest reporters for Borussia Dortmund?
What happened to Ajax stock around recent match results?

notes: Outputs are research context, not investment advice.
Stock-impact language is only valid when a listed-club ticker is directly mapped.
Football club stocks can move for match results, ownership news, liquidity, earnings, qualification, and broader markets.
